settings.title: Flow Mover
settings.intro: Copy flows from your other Homey (e.g. the Homey Pro) to this Homey. Devices and variables are matched by name. The flows on the other Homey are not changed.
settings.step1Hint: Enter the IP address of the Homey that has your flows now, and an API key of that Homey.
settings.keyHelp: How do I create an API key?
settings.key1: Open my.homey.app in a browser and select the Homey that has your flows now (e.g. the Pro) at the top.
settings.key2: Go to Settings → API Keys → New API Key.
settings.key3: Give it a name (e.g. Flow Mover) and only tick read access: Devices, Flows, Logic, Zones, Users and Apps (read only).
settings.key4: Copy the key and paste it below. You can delete it again after moving.
settings.tokenSaved: API key saved (leave empty to keep it)
settings.step2Hint: The devices used in your flows, matched to the device with the same name on this Homey. If a match is wrong or missing, choose it yourself.
settings.otherApp: Matched to a device of another app (e.g. Homey Link): special cards may be missing.
settings.step3Hint: ✓ ready · ! with a remark · ✕ problem (the flow is created but will have broken cards) · = already exists on this Homey.
settings.exists: A flow with this name already exists on this Homey.
settings.issue_app: App not installed on this Homey: {name}
settings.issue_card: Card does not exist on this Homey: {name}
settings.issue_otherApp: {name} is matched to a device of another app
settings.issue_flowRef: Starts the flow “{name}”, which is not (yet) on this Homey
settings.optEnabled: Create flows enabled (otherwise disabled, so they don't run twice while the other Homey still runs them)
settings.confirmBad: Note: {n} flow(s) have a problem and will contain broken cards.
settings.confirmEnabled: The flows will be enabled. Disable them on the other Homey to avoid double actions.
